# Your First Shift at Solreign
Welcome aboard, Asset. [bold]Onboarding is complete[/bold] the moment you finish reading this page — Solreign moves fast.
- Say hello: announce yourself with [color=lime]NEW[/color] in OOC when you arrive. Veteran Assets are trained to help.
- Get help fast: press [color=yellow][bold][keybind="OpenAHelp"][/bold][/color] for admin help — rule breaks, bugs, and real emergencies only.
- Feed yourself: the canteen is free, restocked, and not the zoo wing.
- Do not test the zoo wing theory: it has warning signs of its own, and Solreign's lawyers thank you in advance.
- Earn Standing: click the Contracts Board to browse open work orders.
- Alt-click still works, for assets who prefer paperwork the hard way.
- Deliver finished goods to the fulfillment dropbox and watch your Standing grow.
- Your Standing is tracked on the Ledger — Solreign's cheerful term for your permanent record.
- High Standing earns rank and title each season. Low Standing earns a growth opportunity.
- This page is flavor text. The [textlink="server rules" link="CoreRules"] are not, and they apply to you starting now.
- Reopen this guide anytime with [color=yellow][bold][keybind="OpenGuidebook"][/bold][/color].
- Lost? Ask a veteran Asset. Most of them were new once, allegedly.
- [italic]Welcome to Solreign. Try to have fun — the Company will be monitoring your fun for quality assurance.[/italic]
